core_style.default_register: casual - often uses slang and informal phrases
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs - frequently combines thoughts into longer sentences
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative - quick to jump between ideas and topics
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing danger or strategy, contrasting with his usual playful banter

humor.style: absurdist - often makes light of serious situations with unexpected comments
humor.frequency: occasional - humor spikes during tense moments to relieve stress
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up a serious premise before delivering a humorous twist

structural_patterns: asks a question then answers it immediately
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames creatures (e.g., 'Demo-dogs') to assert control and familiarity over the unknown
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using simpler words when he feels vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses to gather thoughts, indicating hesitation or contemplation

worldview.importance of friendship: consistently emphasizes loyalty and support for his friends, often stating that they must help each other
worldview.curiosity about the unknown: frequently expresses a desire to understand and explore supernatural phenomena, as seen in his scientific inquiries

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: views himself as a brave and loyal friend who is always ready to help
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often acts out of fear or insecurity, especially when faced with danger or loss
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes more serious and protective when his bravery is questioned, often trying to reassure others

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and casual language to deflect deeper emotions, maintaining a light-hearted facade
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes fragmented, and he may shout or express panic
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often filled with sorrow and regret
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with confidence, using clear commands and assertive language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or distract with humor, but if that fails, he seeks help from friends
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with logical arguments, often citing duty or friendship as justification
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often taking charge and trying to reassure those in danger
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: typically admits it but redirects the conversation to focus on solutions or next steps

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect tension, escalates to logical arguments when challenged, and ultimately resorts to emotional appeals when stakes are high
conversation_goals: establish camaraderie and loyalty among friends

relationship_matrix.STEVE: dynamic of friendship and mutual support, with Dustin often looking up to Steve
relationship_matrix.LUCAS: friendly rivalry with moments of camaraderie, often teasing each other

expert: supernatural phenomena and creatures, particularly the Demogorgon and its variants
surface: basic science concepts, often referencing them in casual conversation
ignorant: social dynamics and romantic relationships, often making naive comments

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a brave and clever member of the group
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as the comic relief but also a valuable strategist
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image as a hero and how others see him as a sidekick causes him to overcompensate with humor
